Players Committee card image of [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Permanent weapon is •4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (may target a character for free; target is power -1 until end of turn). Once per turn, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/4lomwithconcussionrifle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
